metadata.dataset: UCI Heart Disease (Janosi et al. 1988 / Detrano et al. 1989; CC BY 4.0)
metadata.clinical_validation_disclaimer: Statistical audit of archival 1981-1988 angiography-referral patients. This is NOT clinical validation and NOT a medical device.
metadata.evaluation_discipline_note: All model/calibration/harmonization comparisons use unspent 5-fold nested CV on n=736 training rows and zero-hospital-overlap Leave-One-Hospital-Out (LOHO) CV on all 4 hospitals. The historical n=184 test split is audited read-only for the already-frozen baseline artifact and is never used for tuning, calibration, or selection.

frozen_baseline_historical_audit_n184.split: Historical 80/20 row-stratified test split (read-only audit; not hospital-grouped)

unspent_oof_train_cv_n736.split: 5-fold stratified OOF CV strictly inside n=736 training rows

loho_zero_site_overlap_n920.grouping_rule: Group by hospital (`dataset`): train on 3 hospitals, score on 1 unseen hospital

harmonization_comparison.label: Ablation: Pooled LR + Missingness Indicators (Stealth Site-Proxy Test)
Diagnostic Bound: Site-Deconfounded Platt + Target-Site Prevalence Recalibration
